description.value: Sushi Wow is a Japanese restaurant on Granville Street in South Vancouver offering a broad menu spanning specialty rolls, sashimi, nigiri, donburi, ramen, and combination platters. The restaurant is notable for its wide range of vegetarian-friendly options alongside seafood-forward classics and large sharing trays. Indoor seating and online ordering make it a flexible stop for cyclists riding the Granville corridor.
